keep-covenants: choose one commandment to give my full effort this week
ask myself in my evening prayer where I kept my covenants today
reread my baptismal covenant in Mosiah 18:8–10
believe-promises: read one chapter of the Book of Mormon and mark every promise
write one promise from the Book of Mormon and what it means for me
share one verse about the Savior’s grace with someone
act-and-share: share one thing I learned from conference with one person
invite a friend or family member to watch one talk with me
write one truth from conference and how I will live it this week
study-the-talks: read or watch one conference talk and write one thing to do
discuss one talk with my family at a meal
listen to one talk on my commute and pray about what to act on
peacemakers: wait an hour and reread before I reply to something that upsets me
replace one sharp phrase I use with “Let us start again”
say “I’m sorry” or “Please forgive me” to one person
seek-friends: spend time with a friend who strengthens my faith
invite a friend to a Church activity or service project
thank a friend who helps me feel the Spirit
bear-witness: say one sincere sentence about the Savior to someone
write my testimony in three sentences and keep it on my phone
bear my testimony at home during family prayer or scripture time
come-unto-christ: pray honestly about one thing that is holding me back
take one step toward the Savior without waiting to feel ready
read the Savior’s promise in John 15:11 and write what it means to me
invite-one: pray to know one person to invite
invite that person to church, an activity, or to meet the missionaries
follow up with a kind message to the person I invited
choose-christ: pray “I trust Thee” about one thing I cannot fix
write what I know is true, to reread on hard days
read Doctrine and Covenants 122:7 and write one thing I am learning
wayward: pray by name for a loved one and hand my worry to the Savior
reach out to that person with love and no agenda
let go of one guilty thought and replace it with a prayer of trust
see-others: pray in the morning for eyes to see one person who needs me
learn and use the name of someone I usually pass by
put my phone away and give one person my full attention
help-not-judge: sit with someone new at church and learn their story
offer one specific kind of help: a ride, a meal, or a call
when I notice a judgment forming, look for a way to help instead
labels: when I label someone, restate it: “a child of God”
tell one person something good I see in them
write Child of God, Child of the covenant, Disciple of Jesus Christ where I will see it
unity: attend one ward activity or service project
reach out to someone who has stepped away or feels on the outside
sit by and talk with someone whose views differ from mine
truth-with-love: ask in prayer whether pride or jealousy is keeping me from making peace
listen all the way through before I respond in a disagreement
make peace with one person I have been at odds with
sacrament: arrive early and think about the Savior before the sacrament
choose one thing to start fresh on during the sacrament
greet someone I do not know well at sacrament meeting
scriptures: read the scriptures for ten minutes at the same time and place
write one sentence about what I learned from the scriptures
read the Book of Mormon with one question in mind
small-and-simple: pair my prayer and scripture reading with breakfast
choose one small spiritual habit and do it every day this month
review each Sunday how my small and simple things went
repent: name one thing in my evening prayer that I will do better tomorrow
make one apology I have been putting off
set a time to talk with my bishop about something I need help with
temple: put a temple visit on my calendar
speak with gratitude about my temple, whatever its size
find one family name to take to the house of the Lord
strong-link: record one family story and share it with a relative
spend thirty minutes on family history
take one family name to the temple or share it with someone who can
fast: read Isaiah 58:6–11 before my next fast
begin and end my fast with prayer for one specific purpose
give a generous fast offering and pray for those it will help
gambling: delete betting apps and unsubscribe from gambling promotions
put the money I would have risked toward savings or giving
spend that hour serving someone or building a skill instead
teachers: pray by name for each person I teach
learn one thing about a class member’s life this week
study how the Savior taught one person before I prepare my lesson
mission: read Doctrine and Covenants 31:1–6 with my own name in it
talk with a returned missionary about why they served
pray to know what the Lord would have me do about a mission
yw-choose-one: pray to choose one of the seven ways and focus on it for three weeks
set a phone-off time each night and keep my phone out of my room
start each day asking Heavenly Father for the Holy Ghost’s companionship
yw-aspirations: study the thirteenth article of faith and write my list of aspirations
choose one item on my list and take a first step
pray over my list and ask Heavenly Father to guide me
